channel.title: Markets
channel.description: Demo "live" items for cnbc-markets: published minutes before the demo starts, so the keyword alerts fire.

item.title: Fed delivers first rate cut of the year, lowering the federal funds rate by a quarter point
item.description: The FOMC cut its benchmark federal funds rate by 25 basis points, citing a cooling labor market.

item.title: Apple (AAPL) shares jump 4% after record iPhone sales in China
item.description: AAPL hit an all-time high as iPhone shipments in China rose 20% from a year earlier.

item.title: Nvidia ($NVDA) unveils new data center chip, shares climb
item.description: NVDA rose 3% after the chipmaker announced its next-generation accelerator.

item.title: Why the aapl ticker trend on social media is not about Apple
item.description: A lowercase meme is unrelated to the iPhone maker (a case-sensitive ticker rule does not match it).
